{{Top|leg}}
'''Kuat Central Plaza''' was within the central sphere on the transit station [[Kuat Passenger Port]]. In order to transfer flights, passengers had to pass through the Central Plaza. Kuat Central Plaza was a city in itself, and was the location of passenger control, starport security, and personnel quarters for the staff and workers of the Kuat Passenger Port.
